references.text: The Lord will scatter you among all peoples from one end of the earth to the other - this verse describes the scattering that Deuteronomy 30:3 promises God will reverse
Jeremiah prophesies that the Lord will gather the exiles and bring them back from all the places where He has driven them
The Lord promises to turn the fortunes of Israel and Judah and bring them back to the land He gave their fathers
The Lord promises to gather His people from all the nations where He has driven them in His anger and bring them back
Ezekiel prophesies that the Lord will gather the people from among the nations and collect them from the countries where they have been scattered
God promises to bring the people from among the nations, gather them from all the lands, and lead them to their own land
Zephaniah prophesies that the Lord will gather the lame and collect those who were driven away, giving them honor in all the lands where they have been put to shame
The psalmist prays that the Lord may gather His people from among the nations to praise His holy name
The Lord builds Jerusalem and gathers the exiles of Israel
Isaiah prophesies that the Lord will lift a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel from the four corners of the earth
Even in enemy lands, God will not reject His people but remember the covenant with their fathers - the foundation for restoration
